page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top left, page number at top right. One column of running text, left. Marginal note in the right margin, beside the lines "cum The-" to "gundum.". Catchword at right below the last line. Gathering signature at foot, centre left.

main_text.p: nec cuiquam per totum agrum vendendi, ac quæstus faciendi causâ cerevisiam coquere liceret: fœdus hoc decennium proximum valeret. Signatum die vi Augusti. Eodem anno, crescente, quem dixi, ab armis Burgundicis metu, cùm fœdus cum Translavicanis confici ob simultates atque odia intestina non posset, cum The-daFœdus cum Fri-siisOrien-talib. con-tra Caro-lum Bur-gundum. & Frisiis orientalibus societas à civitate ordinibusque agrariis inita est pro tuendâ libertate certè memorabilis: de quâ in Historiâ scripsi plenius. Mox alio se vertente Burgundo, legati à civitate & sociis vicinis missi ad Cæsarem Fridericum III, qui & libertatis pristinæ, & pactorum recentium confirmationem, patrocinium-que contra Burgundum peterent: Im-petratumq; de libertate, pactaq; firmata, tota regio denique in tutelam recepta Impe-rii. Sed ex eâ legatione non magnam gratiam, honorémve Ioannes Rengerus & Unico Ripperda retulêre, qui pro Rep. missi sua potiùs quàm reip. agen-tes, potestatem peramplam juris dicun-di, exigendi vectigalis, cudendæ aureæ monetæ (hanc civitas pro se petierat) &

page.notes: Marginal note beside "cum The-da": "Fœdus cum Frisiis Orientalib. contra Carolum Burgundum", set in smaller italic over several lines; the printed line-end hyphens are kept as printed. In the note the word "Frisiis" is split "Fri-" / "fiisOrien-": the long s is read as s, and the printing shows no space between "siis" and "Orien-"; transcribed as printed. "die v i Augusti": printed with a space between v and i, transcribed as "vi". The word "fua" in "missi fua potiùs" is read as "sua" (long s). The catchword "nescio" and the signature "H" sit at the foot. Faint library watermark at lower right is omitted.
